exposure: Time of first intercourse after childbirth
cohort: 181 women with live births in southwest Nigeria
finding: In contrast to the norm, more women in southwest Nigeria are resuming coitus soon after childbirth, with cohabitation and mode of delivery being strong predictors.
mod_finding: Significantly fewer women who had Caesarean section resumed coitus within six months when compared with those who had vaginal deliveries (59.2% versus 78.4%).
